name: Job budgets
summary: Keeps each agency job's budget in view against what has been spent on it, and flags jobs heading over. Crons read and draft internal records only; nothing goes to a client.

job-budgets.evidence: 1 discovery call describes this way of running job budgets

covered_by.burn-monitoring: draft (burn cron reads Xero project totals)
covered_by.overrun-flag: draft (overrun cron flags jobs at the warning share)
covered_by.time-tracking: draft (minutes logged read from the project)
covered_by.cost-capture: draft (task and expense totals read from the project)
covered_by.record-keeping: draft (snapshots kept in the workflow store)
covered_by.budget-build: skill (the budget is set by a person; the agent does not write it)
covered_by.change-request: skill (a change is priced by a person and agreed with the client)

crons.name: burn
crons.summary: Snapshot each job's estimate, spend and minutes logged.

crons.name: overrun
crons.summary: Flag jobs that have spent their warning share of the estimate (22:00 UTC is 8 or 9 am in eastern Australia).

draft_ops_note: Reads only. The workflow never writes to Xero: budgets, time and approvals stay with people.
capabilities: read the job list and totals in Xero
keep burn and overrun snapshots in the workflow store
gaps: Harvest and Teamwork (budget-led time and budget tools in the mining evidence) have no platform in the kit, so their budget and time steps are not mapped.
Xero accounting budgets (accounting.getBudgets) are not read: a budget set in Xero's accounting module is not compared yet.
Only the first page of Xero projects is read; paging is not added.
Job setup (creating the project and assigning people) is not mapped as a live op: it needs an approval design first.
The mining variants file for this workflow (agencies-x-jobbudgets-variants.json) is missing from the mining folder, so the family and step counts rest on the spec and one discovery call.
Change requests, budget reforecasts and client reports are judgment steps for a person; no cron drafts them.

evidence.calls: 1 discovery call for job budgets (variants file missing from the mining folder)
evidence.platforms: Harvest and Teamwork pages mined (neither is in the kit); Xero mapped from the kit ops and the vendor spec
